description: React component for managing credentials, including listing, adding, editing, sharing, and deleting credentials with UI dialogs and API interactions.

methods.name: filterCredentials
methods.description: Filters credentials based on search input.

methods.name: listCredential
methods.description: Opens dialog to add new credential.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Prepares dialog for adding a new credential component.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares dialog for editing an existing credential.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Prepares dialog for sharing a credential.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a credential after user confirmation.

methods.name: onCredentialSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a credential component from dialog.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Refreshes credential list after add/edit operation.
